title: Coforge web — measured visual foundations

subject.what: https://www.coforge.com/ — corporate homepage and its declared CSS token layer

capture.method: Chrome DevTools MCP. Page loaded, network requests filtered to stylesheet, template_* files fetched directly and parsed for :root custom properties. Colour geometry via HLS conversion; contrast via WCAG 2.x relative luminance. Cookie consent declined (Deny all) before the visual capture so the consent overlay did not dim the rendered colours.

sources.what: template_variables.min.css — the declared token layer: colour ramps, type ramp, space, radius, shadow
template_typography.css — every .text-* utility, both breakpoints; shows body wired to Tahoma

Rendered homepage viewport, 2400x1366, consent declined. Not re-fetchable — a live site changes; this is a dated snapshot held in scratch/brand-extraction/raw/ pending human placement in research/sources/.

provenance_note: Written by the main session, not dispatched to brand-director. brand-director consumed this content in its scratch form to author foundations/brand.md; this artifact is the same measurement set promoted to a registered type so brand.md's citations resolve to a durable path rather than into scratch/.
